turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 처음 오시는 분 맞으시죠? 신분증이랑 보험증 좀 보여주시겠어요?
turns.rd: cheoeum osineun bun majeusijyo? sinbunjeungirang boheomjeung jom boyeojusigesseoyo?
turns.en: You're a first-timer, right? Mind showing me your ID and insurance card?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 주소 전화 아픈 곳 알레르기 약 종이에 적어 주세요.
turns.rd: juso jeonhwa apeun got allereugi yak jongie jeogeo juseyo.
turns.en: Write your address, phone, where it hurts, allergies and meds on the form.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 천천히 말해 주세요. 너무 빨라서 따라가기 힘들어요.
turns.rd: cheoncheonhi malhae juseyo. neomu ppallaseo ttaragagi himdeureoyo.
turns.en: Please speak slowly. You're going too fast, I can't keep up.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 네, 하나씩 할게요. 어디가 제일 불편하세요? 전화 잠깐만요!
turns.rd: ne, hanassik halgeyo. eodiga jeil bulpyeonhaseyo? jeonhwa jamkkanmanyo!
turns.en: Okay, one at a time. Where does it hurt most? Phone, hang on!

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 배가 아파요. 어제 떡볶이 세 그릇 먹었는데, 약은 잘 모르겠어요.
turns.rd: baega apayo. eoje tteokbokki se geureut meogeonneunde, yageun jal moreugesseoyo.
turns.en: My stomach hurts. I ate three bowls of tteokbokki yesterday, but I don't really know about the meds.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: (옆에서) 저도 배 아파요! 떡볶이 먹었어요. 뒤에 세 명!
turns.rd: (yeopeseo) jeodo bae apayo! tteokbokki meogeosseoyo. dwie se myeong!
turns.en: (from the side) My stomach hurts too! Had tteokbokki too. Three more behind!

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 헐, 떡볶이 환자 여덟 명째예요. 번호 뽑고 줄 서세요!
turns.rd: heol, tteokbokki hwanja yeodeol myeongjjaeyeyo. beonho ppopgo jul seoseyo!
turns.en: Whoa, eighth tteokbokki patient already. Grab a number and line up!
